meta.title: The Whispering Vault
meta.premise: The abbey of Saint Corvin was abandoned in a single night. Kael has come for the sealed vault beneath it, and the abbot's study is the only room still lit.
meta.scope: One night in the abbey, from the study to the vault and out again. Reaching what is sealed below, or learning why it was sealed, brings the scenario toward an ending; what Kael carries out can follow him into other stories.

opening.title: The Abbot's Study
opening.focus: Can you get the way down to the vault out of this room, and out of Mara?
opening.situation: The only lit room left in the abbey: ledgers stacked to the beams, candle stubs gone cold, and Mara still cataloguing books nobody will read. A flagstone under the desk sits a finger proud of its neighbours.

mara.name: Mara
mara.brief: The abbey's last scribe, cautious and tired, still cataloguing books nobody will read.
mara.goal: Finish the catalogue before anyone strips the abbey
mara.motive: It is the last thing the abbot asked of her

vault-map.name: the vault map
vault-map.brief: A creased chart of the undercroft, marking a stair the abbey's own plans deny. Drawn in an old hand; the undercroft it maps is larger than the abbey standing over it.

tomas.name: Brother Tomas
tomas.brief: A deaf old porter who sweeps the cloister and knows almost nothing about the vault.

elena.name: Elena
elena.brief: The vault's former archivist; she alone remembers the sealing rite, and she names a price before she gives it up. She catalogued the vault ledgers beside Mara for two winters, until the night she went below alone and never came back up. The rite is in her head and nowhere else.
elena.goal: Be paid for the sealing rite
elena.motive: Two winters below earned her that much

cloister-rat.name: a bloated rat
cloister-rat.brief: It has grown fat on the dead garden and does not run from a lantern.
